description: Read a web page as clean markdown and screen for prompt injection before adding to agent context. Returns markdown plus prompt injection verdict (safe, suspicious or malicious), a 0-100 score and matched spans. Respects robots.txt. Price $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"url":"https://example.com/","status":200,"title":"Example Domain","characters":156,"injection":{"verdict":"safe","score":0,"categories":{},"matches":[]},"markdown":"This domain is for use in documentation examples..."}
name: safe_web_read
